player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id} na JoJoJoin, ozwi na planche ya 5x5 na maseli mameko 0-24.
Na ntango ya yo, posa ekolo na yo na seli yoyi ya libanda, kwa mfano '[12]'.
OZWI na kupata ekolo zine ya yo na ndelo moko — maseli manene mine ya kati, ya mwindo, to ya diagonal.
Na Joueur {player_id} ozali '{symbol}'; mpinzani na yo azali '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Likambo oyo batindi elandi lolenge ya malamu te.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ezali cellule ya malamu te. Esengeli kozala kati na 0 mpe 24.

game_action.placed: Mokeli {player_id} akeli kolala moko na ye ({symbol}) na seli {cell}.
